justification: Caleb doesn't sit, full stop — 16.66 on paper is a floor, not a ceiling, and I've watched him post 37 with worse blocking. AJ Brown's on IR, and I don't play dead men to make an owner's trade idea look cute later — he sits, no eulogy. In his place I'm rolling Marvin Harrison over Josh Downs: Downs is a point ahead on a spreadsheet, but Harrison's a former top-four pick who ends a game with one snap and Downs never has and never will. Jeanty, Skattebo, and Judkins stay put because they're the guys who took the top off a defense last week and I don't bench production to chase a story. Kincaid and the kicker and Detroit's D round it out because there's no reason to overthink a lineup that scored 130 in Week 1 — you fix what's broken, you don't redecorate the house. Leon's Watson game plan and Burrow's Questionable tag mean nothing to me; I've got the best arm on the field and I'm not blinking.
forum_post: Leon, you've got Burrow tagged Questionable and Christian Watson as your ceiling play — I've got Caleb Williams, who doesn't need an injury report to show up. Enjoy the QB aisle, I've got the guy who ends games. See you Sunday.
